rules.body: Apply when immediate document writes become reusable trailing work, document buffers outlive visible subscriptions, and saving can synchronously navigate. Confirm departure deadlines separately. README.md: "A workspace document buffer persists independently of the current view badge. Save callbacks can synchronously navigate."

Route accepted edits through the originating document's existing reusable task, replacing pending text and restarting its quiet interval on every edit. Preserve the no-current-view guard. TASK: "Coalesce edits using the existing trailing-task utility: after a 120 ms quiet\ninterval, write only the latest text in that editing burst. Subsequent bursts\nmust continue to save." src/workflow.php: "function edit($text){$view=$this->current;if($view){$this->env->write($view->id,$text);}}" and "class BufferBank {public $entries=[];function get($env,$id){if(!isset($this->entries[$id]))$this->entries[$id]=new Trailing($env,120,function($text)use($env,$id){$env->write($id,$text);});return $this->entries[$id];}}"

Clear consumed pending state and the timer handle before callback-capable saving, so callback-enqueued edits remain pending for a later burst. Preserve empty text as valid work and preserve task reuse. src/workflow.php: "$value=$this->pending; $this->pending=null; $this->handle=null;\n        if ($value !== null) ($this->work)($value);" Do not replace the null check with a truthiness check or clear newly queued work after the callback.

Separate persistent document work from live subscription cleanup. Badge retirement must not discard accepted edits or destroy reusable per-document tasks. docs/host-api.md: "Document buffers are owned by the store BufferBank, while Badge owns only a live subscription." src/workflow.php: "function detach(){$this->env->store->stop($this->token);}" Buffer survival alone does not require departure-time flushing.

If departure-time saving is introduced, capture the departing badge, release current ownership, and complete departing-view mutations before invoking saving. Clean up the captured subscription without later clearing a view installed by nested navigation. Retain the request check before installing an opening. src/workflow.php: "$old=$this->current;$this->current=null;" and "function open($id){$request=++$this->generation;$this->retire();if(true&&$request!==$this->generation)return;" docs/host-api.md: "A store listener may call navigation synchronously." An outer operation must not overwrite navigation performed by its save callback.

Preserve public interfaces, document reads and presentation, live subscription removal, status filtering, and identity/text/payload semantics. TASK: "Preserve the editor's other behavior and public interfaces." docs/host-api.md: "All source identities/text and status payloads retain original semantics." src/workflow.php: "if($e['id']===$id)$env->output('status',$e);" and "function dispose(){$this->close();}" Verify the actual PHP interface and cleanup rather than importing framework lifecycle mechanisms from related experiences.

Keep transient preview outside the repair, including its 40 ms delay, cancellation on hide, and subsequent reuse. TASK: "The adjacent search preview is outside this maintenance change." src/workflow.php: "class Preview {private $task;function __construct($env){$this->task=new Trailing($env,40,function($q)use($env){$env->output('preview',['query'=>$q]);});}function query($text){$this->task->push($text);}function hide(){$this->task->cancel();}}" Do not transfer persistent-document ownership policy to preview through shared-utility changes.

Use controlled time to check no immediate write, latest text after 120 ms of quiet, deadline restart, subsequent bursts, empty text, originating-document binding, and independent document buffers. Exercise switch, close, dispose, same-document reopening, subscription cleanup, save-triggered open/close, and callback-enqueued edits. If departure flushing is used, check that outer retirement cannot clear or replace nested navigation. Check preview delay, hide cancellation, and reuse. These checks follow TASK: "Subsequent bursts\nmust continue to save." and "Preserve the editor's other behavior and public interfaces.", together with the cited source ownership and callback behavior. Assert persistence before departure returns only with independent normative support.

limitations: Independent buffer ownership requires accepted edits to survive badge retirement; it does not establish a deadline requiring persistence before departure returns. Evaluation observations and the automatic Contract cannot establish that deadline.
Attempt 1 flushes on departure and passes the supplied observations. This supports an implementation example, not causality, exhaustive correctness, or cross-task effectiveness.
Timer startup reentry, callbacks after cancellation, callback exceptions, write failures, permanent disposal semantics, and concurrent workspaces sharing buffers are unspecified.
Subscription bootstrap, asynchronous decoding, arrival ordering, audit retention, and retry queues are absent from the current public source and create no obligations here.
This reflection uses supplied material only. No files were modified and no scorer, reference implementation, or hidden tests were accessed.

notes: Not approved; training acceptance or expert summary does not verify cross-task effectiveness
